sloka: पाप अपहम् स्वर् नयनम् दुस्तरम् पार्थिवर्षभैः ।ततोऽब्रवीत् ऋश्य्शृंगम् राजा दशरथः तदा ॥१-१४-५८॥
transliteration: pāpa apaham svar nayanam dustaram pārthivarṣabhaiḥ ।tato'bravīt ṛśyśṛṁgam rājā daśarathaḥ tadā ॥1-14-58॥

translations.english: Having heard his sweet speech, that composed and great-souled lord of kings bowed to him, was filled with the utmost joy, and spoke once again to Rsyasringa.
